note.zh: 插芯片原生 USB 口（D- GPIO19、D+ GPIO20）。连不上时按住 BOOT 插上 USB（或按住 BOOT 按一下 RST）进下载模式；BOOT 只用于下载，清除 Wi-Fi 用电脑端 xrdap wifi clear。
note.en: Use the native USB port (D- GPIO19, D+ GPIO20). If it does not connect, hold BOOT while plugging in USB (or hold BOOT and press RST once) to enter download mode. BOOT is only for download mode; Wi-Fi is cleared from the PC with xrdap wifi clear.

note.zh: 按住 SW1 插上 USB，松开后烧录。
note.en: Hold SW1 while plugging in USB, release it, then flash.

note.zh: 按住 BOOT 插上 USB，松开后烧录。BOOT 只用于下载，清除 Wi-Fi 用 KEY 长按 5 秒或电脑端 xrdap wifi clear。还没有在实物上测过。
note.en: Hold BOOT while plugging in USB, release it, then flash. BOOT is only for download mode; clear Wi-Fi by holding KEY for 5 seconds or with xrdap wifi clear on the PC. Not yet tested on a real board.

note.zh: 插芯片自带的 USB 口（D- GPIO18、D+ GPIO19）。
note.en: Use the built-in USB port (D- GPIO18, D+ GPIO19).

note.zh: 插板上的 USB 口（经 USB 转串口芯片）。
note.en: Use the board USB port (through its USB-to-serial chip).
